scope: D3D8 NONE/4x resource creation, descriptor metadata and depth sample matching. Explicit known-input guest replies plus independent real GPU replay; no native Microsoft HAL claim.
construction: One host CREATE per resource handle, requested NONE/4x on that first command; quality is always zero.
binding: Explicit and NULL-color depth changes require matching multisample type before binding effects; sample metadata comes from the actual current target.
implicit: Back/depth descriptors use the presentation sample type and presentation extent, with display-mode fallback only for unspecified dimensions.
limits: Solid full-target colors validate resolve/readback and lifetime. This fixture does not measure MSAA edge coverage, complete Reset boundaries, surface COM pointer identity, or native Microsoft HAL pixels.
